summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /project-map page + regression pass on rest of site. Map renders correctly with Carto Dark raster tiles (styleLoaded=true, tilesLoaded=true), all 19 numbered markers show, filters work (All=19, Completed=13, Ongoing=06), info card opens/closes, sidebar list, mobile chip selector, legend, and filter-based selection clearing all function. Regression: home, /projects (19 cards), /projects/my-dream-nest (DAY|NIGHT + VISIT section), /about, /contact, and navbar PROJECT MAP link all load. Two issues noted: a JS pageerror `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')` fires during navigation, and clicking overlapping markers at initial zoom may select an adjacent project (marker-01 nest opened marker-03 avasa info card).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='map-marker-my-dream-nest' at initial zoom opened the info card for my-dream-avasa (View Project href=/projects/my-dream-avasa). Markers 01-04 overlap tightly at the fit-bounds zoom (~14.35). Playwright force-click on the exact testid still triggered a neighboring marker's onClick, suggesting hit-testing/z-order issue when marker DOM elements overlap. Real user taps on mobile/desktop near clustered markers would hit the same problem.

Uncaught pageerror observed during navigation: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')`. Likely from thumbOf() when a project has cover set but the string does not contain 'elevation.jpg' — OR from a similar .replace() call elsewhere. Recommend guarding replace() calls and adding a try/catch or optional chaining.

issues: Page body text contains NEITHER 'G+4' nor 'G+5'. Per STRICT DATA RULE 'Ivy is G+4 (never G+5)'. If the spec is to display the G+4 designation on the detail page, it is missing. If it's only a data-model attribute, this is fine — please verify.

action_items: Investigate & fix the 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)' pageerror (likely thumbOf() or a project field missing).

Improve marker click hit-testing so overlapping markers (01-04 near Ameenpur) correctly select the tapped one — e.g., raise z-index of the hovered marker, or nudge duplicate lat/lng with a small offset, or use pointer-events routing.
Verify whether Ivy detail page should show 'G+4' label; if yes, add it (it is currently absent).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectMap.jsx marker rebuild useEffect dependency is `[filter, selected === null]` — passing a boolean expression is unusual; consider `[filter]` and letting the separate highlight effect manage selection styles (already present).
thumbOf() blindly calls .replace on p.cover; if cover exists but lacks 'elevation.jpg', replace returns the same string (safe), but if cover is a non-string it will throw. Add typeof guard.
window.__map is exposed globally — fine for debugging but should be gated behind NODE_ENV !== 'production' before ship.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map page is functionally solid (tiles load, 19 markers, filters, sidebar, mobile chips, info card, close, filter-clears-selection all verified). Two remaining issues: (1) pageerror on .replace of undefined — reproduce by navigating through home->projects->/projects/my-dream-nest->/projects/my-dream-ivy while watching pageerror listener; (2) overlapping-marker click routing issue at the default fit-bounds zoom for clustered slugs my-dream-nest/casa/avasa/skylark. window.__map is available on /project-map for debugging.
